title: StockSmart Plant Shutdown Pauses and Credit Hold Pauses — Basis Questions and Answers
content:
The StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program recognises two kinds of pause: a plant shutdown pause the customer asks for, and a credit hold pause on certain tiers' credit hold rule.

### The rule

A customer may pause an active program for a plant shutdown; a plant shutdown pause is recorded only when the number of plant shutdown pauses recorded on the program in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of the new pause request is below the tier's pauses allowed per year. A program paused for a plant shutdown resumes no later than the tier's longest pause in calendar days after the first paused day. Count calendar days with the first paused day as day 1; the program resumes on or before the day after the last allowed paused day, and a longer shutdown requires a termination or an approved exception outside this charter. A program on a tier whose credit hold service rule is suspend is paused with the pause reason credit hold while the customer's Commercial Credit Account is on hold, and resumes on the day the hold is released; credit hold pauses do not count toward the pauses allowed per year. No visits, replenishment or consumption billing occur on paused days, and fees follow the program fee rules of the StockSmart Vendor-Managed Inventory Program.

### Questions answered by the rule

**What decides whether a new plant shutdown pause may be recorded?** Corbett's pause records for the program: the plant shutdown pauses recorded in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the date of the new request. The pause is recorded only when that count is below the tier's allowance. Credit hold pauses are not counted.

**From which day is a shutdown pause counted?** From the first paused day, which is day 1.

**Hypothetical: a tier allowing pauses of up to 30 calendar days.** Day 1 is the first paused day and day 30 the last allowed paused day; the program resumes on or before day 31.

| Resumption day (counting the first paused day as day 1) | Within the rule? |
|---|---|
| day 31 | yes — the day after the last allowed paused day |
| day 20 | yes — earlier than day 31 |
| day 32 | no — a longer shutdown requires a termination or an approved exception outside this charter |

**Hypothetical allowance count.** On a tier allowing 1 pause in a rolling 12 months, a program with one plant shutdown pause already recorded inside the window has a count of 1, which is not below 1; a new plant shutdown pause is not recorded. With none recorded inside the window the count is 0 and the pause is recorded.

**When does a credit hold pause end?** On the day the hold on the customer's Commercial Credit Account is released.
